generations.prompt: Inside a cold grey stone chapter house of a medieval abbey, tall windows, brothers in white habits seated along the wall. A standing older brother in a white habit holds a heavy open book out toward a young man in a rough brown habit with dark hair and a short beard, who stares at the page blankly; the older brother patiently turns the book the right way up in front of him, then taps a line of the text firmly twice with his forefinger and looks at the young man; the young man looks at the page, then at the brother, lost, and his mouth stays shut; the seated brothers watch, one shaking his head. Camera static, medium shot. Photoreal, cinematic film look, 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain. No text, no captions.
